description: Details of an Action Plan Verification Method

id.description: Unique identifier of the verification method.

active.description: Whether this verification method is enabled for selection in Action Plan items. When false, it is hidden from selection in new plan items.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the verification method was created. ISO 8601 format.

name.description: Display name of the verification method.

source_key.description: System key identifying a built-in verification method. Null for user-created custom methods.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the verification method was last modified. ISO 8601 format.
